basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old enthusiast from Leipzig, Germany, trying to navigate my way through the vast world of Reddit. I have a keen interest in trading card games, especially Yu-Gi-Oh!, and enjoy sharing strategies and tips with fellow duelists. I work part-time at a local game store, which fuels my passion for card games. In my free time, I dabble in mobile games like Clash Royale. I'm currently single and often browse Reddit during late evenings after work. Music is another passion of mine, although I'm not fluent in any language other than German, which sometimes makes it challenging to find certain songs or lyrics.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I grew up playing card games with friends and gradually developed a deep understanding of Yu-Gi-Oh! through tournaments and online resources. I have no formal education in game design but have learned a lot through hands-on experience and community interactions.
